# datadog_status_page_components (Data Source)

Use this data source to list the components and groups of a Datadog status page, for discovery or import. An empty result is not an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "datadog_status_page_components" "all" {
  page_id = "5e9bd12c-6cde-4247-85fd-98045fbd9b8f"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `page_id` (String) The ID of the status page whose components to list.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Filter the results to components with this exact name.
- `type` (String) Filter the results by type (`component` or `group`).

### Read-Only

- `components` (List of Object) The list of matching components and groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--components))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--components"></a>
### Nested Schema for `components`

Read-Only:

- `group_id` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `position` (Number)
- `type` (String)
